Name: Tappable Palm Trees (CP)
Author: dyanosis
Description:
This is based on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/18901754]aedenthorn's[/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10661]Tappable Palm Trees[/url]. This is a conversion of that mod to only require [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿﻿. Does not, currently, support trees outside the vanilla Palm Trees (may change this later).

[b]Config[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Enabled [/b]- Whether the mod works or not. Default [b]true[/b].
[*][b]Product [/b]- What product is produced. Works with any item (including modded items). Requires the full Item ID. Default [b](0)247 [/b](Oil). Item ID gives more flexibility removes the possibility of conflicting items.
[*][b]Days Until Ready [/b]- How many days the Tapper (and, by vanilla standards, the Heavy Tapper) takes to produce. Default [b]7[/b]. 7 was chosen to be more like other mods that make tappers take 7 days.
[/list]
Any changes made to the config will require you to remove the Tapper/Heavy Tapper and put it back on for it to take effect due to how Tappers work.
[size=5][img]https://i.imgur.com/suHzq2E.png[/img][/size]
[list]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿﻿.
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]﻿
[img]https://i.imgur.com/M7KlO44.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Compatible with...
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 or later;
[*]Linux, macOS, and Windows;
[*]single-player and multiplayer
[/list][*]No known mod conflicts.
[/list]
[b]Credits[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/18901754]aedenthorn[/url][b] [/b]for the original mod
[*]People on Nexus for being so open to people wanting to be creative.
[/list]
Like this mod? [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/dyanosis/mods]Check out my other mods![/url]
